Description: GuardDuty detectors do not have RDS Protection enabled to analyze login activity and identify potential security threats on database instances.
Risk: Without RDS Protection, anomalous database logins and unauthorized access attempts can go unnoticed. Attackers using stolen or brute-forced credentials may access sensitive data, alter database schemas, or pivot through the database, compromising confidentiality, integrity, and availability.

Recommendation.Text: Consider enabling GuardDuty RDS Protection for all detectors across accounts and regions to continuously monitor RDS login events and detect anomalous database access patterns.
